# The cash sale again, this time worth more than the invoice owes.
#
# `Assets:Bank:USD +120.00` against `Income:Sales USD −120.00`, on a 100.00
# invoice. The extra 20.00 is what takes it down the overpayment arm — the one
# that carves the settling split in two and returns before the guards placed
# after it.
#
# So the exact-amount file was refused and this one was not: the revenue split
# was re-accounted onto the receivable and divided 100/20, the invoice read
# paid, 20.00 was parked as the customer's credit, and the entry balanced.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, bank +120.00 against income
# −120.00, neither split in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-03-20 * "Cash sale, too much, income baked in"

	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 120.00 USD
		guid: "cafe99aacafebbccafeddeecafeff001"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Income:Sales USD -120.00 USD
